name: Cyclone of Claws (Monster)
body:
The monster can unleash a rapid assault of natural attacks.

Prerequisite: Natural attack, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit: When the monster takes a full attack action using only natural attacks, it may make one additional attack. This attack must be made with the natural attack with the highest base attack bonus, and suffers no penalty to its attack roll.
